WHAT: Vinted's catalog API requires `Authorization: Bearer <token>` where token comes from the `access_token_web` cookie received when doing a GET to the Vinted homepage. Also, color and size are structured filter params, not text.
WHERE: lib/vinted.ts
HOW: 
1. GET https://www.vinted.lt → grab `access_token_web` from Set-Cookie header
2. Use as Bearer token on `GET https://www.vinted.lt/api/v2/catalog/items`
3. Pass `color_ids[]=26` and `size_ids[]=208` as query params (not in search_text)
4. Cache token per user for 30min to avoid rate limits
GOTCHA: Old approach of sending cookies directly doesn't work — must use the JWT as Bearer. Browser CORS blocks client-side token fetching so it must be server-side. Per-user token caching means 100 users = 100 separate sessions.
COLOR IDS: BLACK=1, WHITE=12, GREY=20, NAVY=29, BLUE=3, RED=5, etc.
SIZE IDS: See lib/vinted-sizes.ts for full mapping (shoe 44=788, clothing M=208, etc.)
